services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: Pretend City’s private facility rental package is $2,700 for members and $3,000 for nonmembers. Membership must be active at time of reservation for membership rate. Rental includes two hours private use of the museum after hours. This package includes admission for up to 100 guests (adults and children).. Infants under 12 months are free. Additional guests are $15 per person with maximum limit of 200 guests. Use of facility resources such as community rooms, tables and chairs are available for an additional fee.
